figures.ask_en: The part is 1693 bp. This map says 3792. Where did the rest come from?
figures.ask_zh: 這個部件是 1693 bp，圖上卻寫 3792。多出來的是什麼？
figures.a_en: The map is the whole plasmid, not the part. The insert is the light-sensing unit: PliaG, R0-RBS, ccaS-m3, then the B0015 double terminator. That is the 1693 bp we deposited. Everything else is pSTK-1B backbone, the bla CDS and a high-copy ColE1 origin, so it is kept in E. coli on ampicillin. The name still carries sfGFP from the parent dropout vector.
figures.a_zh: 圖畫的是整個質體，不是部件本身。插入片段是光感測單元：PliaG、R0-RBS、ccaS-m3，再接 B0015 雙終止子，這就是我們存放的 1693 bp。其餘全是 pSTK-1B 骨架：bla CDS 和高拷貝 ColE1 起點，所以在大腸桿菌裡用安比西林篩選。構築名稱裡仍留著母載體的 sfGFP 字樣。
figures.q_en: The construct name reads pSTK-1B-sfGFP. What does sfGFP mean here?
figures.q_zh: 構築名稱寫著 pSTK-1B-sfGFP，這裡的 sfGFP 是什麼意思？
opt_en: It names the parent dropout vector; the sfGFP cassette was replaced by this insert
sfGFP is co-expressed as a reporter of ccaS-m3 activity
sfGFP is translationally fused to the C-terminus of CcaS-m3
sfGFP sits on the backbone as a transformation control
opt_zh: 那是母載體 dropout 的名字；sfGFP 卡匣已被這段插入片段取代
sfGFP 與 ccaS-m3 共同表達，作為活性報導基因
sfGFP 以轉譯融合方式接在 CcaS-m3 的 C 端
sfGFP 留在骨架上作為轉型對照
figures.trap_en: Reading sfGFP in the construct name as a reporter that is still present in this plasmid.
figures.trap_zh: 把構築名稱裡的 sfGFP 當成這個質體裡還存在的報導基因。

figures.ask_en: This is not a SubtiToolKit vector. What is it, and why use it?
figures.ask_zh: 這不是 SubtiToolKit 的載體。那是什麼？為什麼用它？
figures.a_en: It is Csn-AcdS-6xHis sitting in pGEM-T Easy, 4212 bp in total. You can see AmpR, the ColE1 ori, an f1 ori, lacZ-alpha split across the cloning site, and T7 and SP6 promoters flanking the insert. It is a holding step: PCR the coding sequence, confirm it here by blue-white screening and T7/SP6 colony PCR, then take the verified fragment into Golden Gate. No sfGFP dropout is involved.
figures.a_zh: 這是 Csn-AcdS-6xHis 放在 pGEM-T Easy 裡，全長 4212 bp。圖上看得到 AmpR、ColE1 起點、f1 起點、被選殖位點切開的 lacZ-alpha，以及兩側的 T7 與 SP6 啟動子。它只是暫存步驟：先 PCR 出編碼序列，用藍白篩選和 T7/SP6 菌落 PCR 在這裡確認，再把驗證過的片段帶進 Golden Gate。這裡沒有 sfGFP dropout。
kw_zh: 進 Golden Gate 前的暫存
figures.q_en: How were correct clones picked in this vector?
figures.q_zh: 在這個載體裡，正確的選殖株是怎麼挑出來的？
opt_en: White colonies from lacZ-alpha disruption, then colony PCR with T7 and SP6
White colonies from the pSTK sfGFP dropout being replaced
Green versus red light screening of the CcaSR output
Erythromycin selection after transformation into B. subtilis
opt_zh: lacZ-alpha 被破壞而產生白色菌落，再用 T7 與 SP6 做菌落 PCR
pSTK 的 sfGFP dropout 被取代而產生白色菌落
用綠光與紅光篩選 CcaSR 的輸出
轉型進枯草桿菌後用紅黴素篩選
figures.trap_en: Assuming every entry clone in this project used the pSTK sfGFP dropout for white-colony screening.
figures.trap_zh: 以為這個專案裡每個入門選殖株都是用 pSTK 的 sfGFP dropout 來做白色菌落篩選。

figures.ask_en: Why is this map 7191 bp when the deposited part is 1093 bp?
figures.ask_zh: 存放的部件是 1093 bp，為什麼這張圖是 7191 bp？
figures.a_en: Because the drawing is the whole plasmid. The insert is pVeg, RiboJ, R0-RBS, SamyQ, LEA14 2.1 with a 6xHis, and B0015, which is the 1093 bp we deposited. The other 6098 bp is the pSTK-EXP1 backbone: Erm from the STK124 part, the bla CDS, repB, ColE1 and a truncated pBR322 ori. That same 6098 bp backbone is under every EXP1 map in this set.
figures.a_zh: 因為圖畫的是整個質體。插入片段是 pVeg、RiboJ、R0-RBS、SamyQ、帶 6xHis 的 LEA14 2.1，再接 B0015，就是我們存放的 1093 bp。其餘 6098 bp 是 pSTK-EXP1 骨架：來自 STK124 的 Erm、bla CDS、repB、ColE1 和截短的 pBR322 起點。這組圖裡每張 EXP1 地圖下面都是同樣的 6098 bp 骨架。
kw_en: Erm plus bla on the map
kw_zh: 圖上同時有 Erm 與 bla
figures.q_en: The map shows both an Erm cassette and a bla CDS. Which one selects in B. subtilis?
figures.q_zh: 圖上同時有 Erm 卡匣與 bla CDS。在枯草桿菌裡是靠哪一個篩選？
opt_en: Erythromycin; bla is the E. coli marker on the shuttle backbone
Ampicillin, because bla is the larger and more prominent CDS
Chloramphenicol, as on the Level 0 entry vector
Both, since the shuttle backbone works the same way in each host
opt_zh: 紅黴素；bla 是穿梭骨架上給大腸桿菌用的標記
安比西林，因為 bla 是圖上比較大、比較顯眼的 CDS
氯黴素，和 Level 0 入門載體一樣
兩者皆是，因為穿梭骨架在兩個宿主裡作用相同
figures.trap_en: Seeing bla on the map and calling the construct an ampicillin plasmid in B. subtilis.
figures.trap_zh: 看到圖上有 bla，就說這個構築在枯草桿菌裡是安比西林質體。

figures.ask_en: Point at the insert here and tell me what the rest of the plasmid is.
figures.ask_zh: 指出這裡的插入片段，其餘的質體是什麼？
figures.a_en: The insert is the short run near the left: a small SamyQ arrow, then LEA14 2.1-Histag with the 6xHis marked under it. That is 564 bp of a 2645 bp plasmid. The rest is pSTK-0C, the Level 0 entry vector: a chloramphenicol acetyltransferase CDS drawn as two arrows because it straddles the point where the circle was cut open for drawing, plus a high-copy ColE1 origin.
figures.a_zh: 插入片段在偏左的短段：一個小的 SamyQ 箭頭，接著是 LEA14 2.1-Histag，下面標著 6xHis。那是 2645 bp 質體裡的 564 bp。其餘是 Level 0 入門載體 pSTK-0C：一個氯黴素乙醯轉移酶 CDS 被畫成兩個箭頭，因為它跨過了為了畫圖而把環狀質體切開的那一點，另外還有高拷貝 ColE1 起點。
kw_en: CAT split by the cut point
kw_zh: CAT 被切開點分成兩段
figures.q_en: Why does the chloramphenicol acetyltransferase appear twice on this map?
figures.q_zh: 為什麼氯黴素乙醯轉移酶在圖上出現兩次？
opt_en: It is one CDS, split by where the circular plasmid was linearised for the drawing
There are two copies, giving a higher level of chloramphenicol resistance
One is CAT and the other is a second, unrelated resistance marker
The clone carries a tandem duplication picked up during cloning
opt_zh: 那是一個 CDS，被畫圖時把環狀質體線性化的位置切成兩段
有兩份拷貝，可以提高氯黴素抗性
一個是 CAT，另一個是第二個不相干的抗性標記
這個選殖株在選殖過程中產生了串聯重複
figures.trap_en: Counting the two arrows as two separate genes rather than one CDS across the linearisation point.
figures.trap_zh: 把兩個箭頭算成兩個基因，而不是一個跨過線性化位置的 CDS。

figures.ask_en: What is this, and what separates it from the LEA14 map next to it?
figures.ask_zh: 這是什麼？它和旁邊那張 LEA14 地圖差在哪裡？
figures.a_en: Same Level 0 vector, different cargo. SamyQ, then an AcdS 2.1-Histag arrow with the 6xHis marked beneath, 1125 bp deposited inside a 3206 bp plasmid. The backbone is identical to the LEA14 one, chloramphenicol acetyltransferase and the ColE1 origin. Apart from the gene name on the arrow, the thing that separates them is total length: AcdS is about 560 bp longer than LEA14.
figures.a_zh: 同一個 Level 0 載體，不同的貨物。SamyQ 之後是 AcdS 2.1-Histag 箭頭，下面標著 6xHis，3206 bp 質體裡存放了 1125 bp。骨架和 LEA14 那張完全一樣：氯黴素乙醯轉移酶和 ColE1 起點。除了箭頭上的基因名稱，分辨兩者的就是總長度：AcdS 比 LEA14 長約 560 bp。
figures.q_en: What does the 2.1 on the AcdS arrow refer to?
figures.q_zh: AcdS 箭頭上的 2.1 是指什麼？
opt_en: A recoded version: 12 of the first 15 acdS codons were changed to open up the mRNA start
The second clone picked from the first plate
Version 2 of the SnapGene map file, revision 1
An insert of about 2.1 kb
opt_zh: 重新編碼的版本：acdS 前 15 個密碼子中有 12 個被改過，以打開 mRNA 起始端的結構
第一塊培養皿上挑出的第二個選殖株
SnapGene 地圖檔的第 2 版、第 1 次修訂
大約 2.1 kb 的插入片段
figures.trap_en: Reading 2.1 as a size in kilobases or as a clone number rather than a sequence variant.
figures.trap_zh: 把 2.1 讀成 kb 大小或選殖株編號，而不是序列變體。

figures.ask_en: The same picture sits on two part pages. Which page does it actually match?
figures.ask_zh: 同一張圖出現在兩個部件頁面上。它其實對應哪一個？
figures.a_en: It is the Level 1 output unit in pSTK-1D: PcpcG2-veg, EEBD, R0-RBS, Csn-AcdS-Histag with 6xHis, and B0015, on a bla and ColE1 backbone, 3857 bp total. Take off the 2108 bp pSTK-1D backbone and the insert is 1749 bp, which is BBa_26PGPSGK. The other page, BBa_26Q3LKZU, is listed at 2617 bp, 868 bp larger. The map fits the corrected deposit, not the older one.
figures.a_zh: 這是 pSTK-1D 裡的 Level 1 輸出單元：PcpcG2-veg、EEBD、R0-RBS、帶 6xHis 的 Csn-AcdS-Histag，再接 B0015，骨架是 bla 與 ColE1，全長 3857 bp。扣掉 2108 bp 的 pSTK-1D 骨架，插入片段是 1749 bp，也就是 BBa_26PGPSGK。另一個頁面 BBa_26Q3LKZU 登記 2617 bp，多了 868 bp。這張圖對應的是修正後的存放版本，不是舊的那個。
figures.q_en: What are the extra 868 bp in BBa_26Q3LKZU?
figures.q_zh: BBa_26Q3LKZU 多出來的 868 bp 是什麼？
opt_en: The 1045 bp third-party BBa_254UKC9E, PcpcG2 plus an sfGFP reporter, where the team's own 177 bp PcpcG2-veg belongs
An sfGFP dropout that was never excised from the pSTK-1D vector
A second copy of the EEBD-RBS0 regulatory region
The pSTK-1D backbone mistakenly counted into the part length
opt_zh: 1045 bp 的第三方部件 BBa_254UKC9E，也就是 PcpcG2 加一個 sfGFP 報導基因，取代了團隊自己的 177 bp PcpcG2-veg
pSTK-1D 載體裡沒切掉的 sfGFP dropout
多了一份 EEBD-RBS0 調控區
把 pSTK-1D 骨架誤算進部件長度
figures.trap_en: Assuming one figure on two pages means the two pages hold the same construct.
figures.trap_zh: 以為同一張圖放在兩個頁面上，就代表兩個頁面是同一個構築。

figures.ask_en: Walk me left to right across the insert on this map.
figures.ask_zh: 請從左到右講一遍這張圖上的插入片段。
figures.a_en: From the left edge: pVeg, RiboJ, the R0-RBS and its scar, SamyQ, then the AcdS 2.1-Histag arrow, then the B0015 double terminator. That is the 1654 bp deposited part. After it comes the pSTK-EXP1 backbone, Erm from the STK124 part, bla, repB, ColE1 and a truncated pBR322 ori, for 7752 bp total. The map shows order and annotation, not a sequencing read.
figures.a_zh: 從左邊開始：pVeg、RiboJ、R0-RBS 和它的 scar、SamyQ，接著是 AcdS 2.1-Histag 箭頭，然後是 B0015 雙終止子。那就是存放的 1654 bp。再來是 pSTK-EXP1 骨架：來自 STK124 的 Erm、bla、repB、ColE1 和截短的 pBR322 起點，全長 7752 bp。圖顯示的是順序與註解，不是定序結果。
figures.q_en: This plasmid is 7752 bp and the Csn version of the same unit is 7767. What is the 15 bp?
figures.q_zh: 這個質體是 7752 bp，同一單元的 Csn 版本是 7767。那 15 bp 是什麼？
opt_en: Csn is 108 bp and SamyQ is 93 bp, so swapping the signal peptide costs 15 bp
Only the Csn version carries the C-terminal 6xHis tag
AcdS 2.1 has five extra recoded codons compared with wild-type acdS
The Csn version uses a longer terminator than B0015
opt_zh: Csn 是 108 bp、SamyQ 是 93 bp，換訊號胜肽就差 15 bp
只有 Csn 版本帶 C 端的 6xHis 標籤
AcdS 2.1 比野生型 acdS 多了五個重新編碼的密碼子
Csn 版本用的終止子比 B0015 長
figures.trap_en: Treating the two signal peptides as interchangeable in length as well as in function.
figures.trap_zh: 以為兩個訊號胜肽不只功能可互換，長度也一樣。

figures.ask_en: What does this growth curve settle, and what does it leave open?
figures.ask_zh: 這條生長曲線解決了什麼？又留下了什麼沒解決？
figures.a_en: OD600 of WB800 carrying the CcaSR system, red 100% on the left and green 100% on the right, read at 2, 4, 6, 8 and 24 hours. Both end in the same place, 1.026 and 1.017, against a blank of 0.057 to 0.061. So green light does not cost growth. It says nothing about expression or secretion. Red is n=1, and nothing was read between 8 and 24 hours.
figures.a_zh: 帶有 CcaSR 系統的 WB800 的 OD600，左邊紅光 100%、右邊綠光 100%，在 2、4、6、8 和 24 小時讀取。兩邊最後落在同一個地方，1.026 與 1.017，空白值是 0.057 到 0.061。所以綠光不會損失生長。它對表達或分泌沒有任何說明。紅光只有 n=1，而且 8 到 24 小時之間沒有量測。
figures.q_en: What does the straight segment from 8 h to 24 h represent?
figures.q_zh: 從 8 小時到 24 小時那段直線代表什麼？
opt_en: Nothing was measured in between; it is a line joining two points
Steady exponential growth continued at a constant rate
The culture had entered stationary phase
Hourly readings were taken and the points overlap at this scale
opt_zh: 中間沒有量測；那只是連接兩個點的直線
指數生長以固定速率持續進行
菌液已進入穩定期
其實每小時都有讀值，只是在這個比例尺下點重疊了
figures.trap_en: Reading the 8 to 24 hour segment as measured growth kinetics rather than interpolation.
figures.trap_zh: 把 8 到 24 小時那段當成量到的生長動力學，而不是內插的直線。

figures.ask_en: The deposited insert is 183 bp. Find it on this map.
figures.ask_zh: 存放的插入片段是 183 bp。在這張圖上找出來。
figures.a_en: It is the short arrow at the far left, labelled SamyQ-BoPep4 2.1-Histag, with 6xHis marked underneath. The whole fusion is drawn as one feature rather than split into signal peptide, peptide and tag. That is 183 bp of a 2263 bp plasmid; the rest is pSTK-0C, chloramphenicol acetyltransferase and the ColE1 origin. BoPep4 itself is only 69 bp, so most of the insert is signal and tag.
figures.a_zh: 就是最左邊那個短箭頭，標示 SamyQ-BoPep4 2.1-Histag，下面標著 6xHis。整個融合被畫成一個特徵，沒有拆成訊號胜肽、胜肽和標籤。那是 2263 bp 質體裡的 183 bp；其餘是 pSTK-0C、氯黴素乙醯轉移酶和 ColE1 起點。BoPep4 本身只有 69 bp，所以插入片段大部分是訊號和標籤。
kw_zh: 一個箭頭畫完整個融合
figures.q_en: Of the 183 bp insert, how much is the BoPep4 peptide itself?
figures.q_zh: 183 bp 的插入片段裡，BoPep4 胜肽本身佔多少？
opt_en: 69 bp; the other 114 bp is the 93 bp SamyQ signal plus the His tag
All 183 bp; the insert is the peptide coding sequence
108 bp, the length of the secretion signal
141 bp, the same as the Bopep4 15-23 truncation
opt_zh: 69 bp；其餘 114 bp 是 93 bp 的 SamyQ 訊號加上 His 標籤
全部 183 bp；插入片段就是胜肽的編碼序列
108 bp，也就是分泌訊號的長度
141 bp，和 Bopep4 15-23 截短版一樣
figures.trap_en: Taking the deposited part length as the length of the peptide it encodes.
figures.trap_zh: 把存放的部件長度當成它編碼的胜肽長度。

figures.ask_en: This is the whole system. Name the four units in the order you see them.
figures.ask_zh: 這是完整系統。照你看到的順序說出四個單元。
figures.a_en: Left to right: PtagC with RBS driving Ho1 and pcyA, closed by L3S2P21; then PliaG with ccaSm3; then pVeg with ccaR; then PcpcG2-veg with RiboJ, R0-RBS, SamyQ and the AcdS arrow labelled ACC. B0015 closes the last three. 10,377 bp in all on the pSTK-EXP2 backbone with a chloramphenicol cassette, repB, ColE1 and a truncated pBR322 ori.
figures.a_zh: 由左到右：PtagC 加 RBS 驅動 Ho1 與 pcyA，由 L3S2P21 收尾；接著是 PliaG 加 ccaSm3；再來是 pVeg 加 ccaR；最後是 PcpcG2-veg 加 RiboJ、R0-RBS、SamyQ 和標示為 ACC 的 AcdS 箭頭。後三個單元都由 B0015 收尾。全長 10,377 bp，骨架是 pSTK-EXP2，含氯黴素卡匣、repB、ColE1 和截短的 pBR322 起點。
figures.q_en: What does the evidence behind this Level 2 map actually support?
figures.q_zh: 這張 Level 2 地圖背後的證據，實際上支持到哪裡？
opt_en: That the four modules are present in this order; the sequence between junctions is unverified
That all 10,377 bp were sequenced and are free of mutations
That the circuit was shown to switch output on under green light
That each module was individually sequenced inside this finished plasmid
opt_zh: 四個模組以這個順序存在；接點之間的序列尚未驗證
全部 10,377 bp 都已定序且沒有突變
已證實電路在綠光下會把輸出打開
每個模組都在這個完成的質體裡個別定序過
figures.trap_en: Letting the Level 1 caption "sequence-verified" carry over to a 10.4 kb Level 2 plasmid that was only checked by junction PCR.
figures.trap_zh: 把 Level 1 圖說的「序列已驗證」套到只做過接點 PCR 的 10.4 kb Level 2 質體上。

figures.ask_en: The page says 2602 bp and this map says 3842. Do those two agree?
figures.ask_zh: 頁面寫 2602 bp，這張圖寫 3842。這兩個數字對得上嗎？
figures.a_en: No. The map is the whole plasmid, so the insert is 3842 minus the 2108 bp pSTK-1D backbone, which is 1734 bp. That is the corrected construct carrying the team's own 177 bp PcpcG2-veg, deposited separately as BBa_263IW021. The page this figure sits on is the older 2602 bp version with the 1045 bp third-party part, 868 bp larger. One of the reverse primers is still named Csn:ACCD on a SamyQ construct.
figures.a_zh: 對不上。圖畫的是整個質體，所以插入片段是 3842 減掉 2108 bp 的 pSTK-1D 骨架，等於 1734 bp。那是帶團隊自己 177 bp PcpcG2-veg 的修正版構築，另外以 BBa_263IW021 存放。這張圖所在的頁面是舊的 2602 bp 版本，含 1045 bp 的第三方部件，多了 868 bp。另外，SamyQ 構築上有一支反向引子仍叫 Csn:ACCD。
figures.q_en: Which deposit does the construct drawn here actually correspond to?
figures.q_zh: 這裡畫的構築，實際上對應哪一個存放部件？
opt_en: BBa_263IW021, the corrected 1734 bp version
BBa_26DE5E2Q, the page the figure sits on
BBa_26PGPSGK, the Csn version of the same unit
BBa_26GJIT8W, the PcpcG2-veg promoter on its own
opt_zh: BBa_263IW021，修正後的 1734 bp 版本
BBa_26DE5E2Q，也就是這張圖所在的頁面
BBa_26PGPSGK，同一單元的 Csn 版本
BBa_26GJIT8W，單獨的 PcpcG2-veg 啟動子
figures.trap_en: Trusting the length printed on the page because the figure happens to sit under it.
figures.trap_zh: 因為圖剛好放在那個頁面下方，就相信頁面上印的長度。

figures.ask_en: What is missing from this unit that every output unit has?
figures.ask_zh: 這個單元少了每個輸出單元都有的什麼東西？
figures.a_en: A signal peptide and a 6xHis tag. This is the transduction unit in pSTK-1C: pVeg, R0-RBS, ccaR, B0015, 964 bp of a 3243 bp plasmid, with bla and a ColE1 origin as backbone. There is no SamyQ or Csn on it and no His tag, and no RiboJ either. CcaR is the response regulator and works inside the cell, so it is neither secreted nor pulled down on nickel.
figures.a_zh: 少了訊號胜肽和 6xHis 標籤。這是 pSTK-1C 裡的傳遞單元：pVeg、R0-RBS、ccaR、B0015，3243 bp 質體裡的 964 bp，骨架是 bla 與 ColE1 起點。上面沒有 SamyQ 或 Csn，也沒有 His 標籤，連 RiboJ 都沒有。CcaR 是反應調節蛋白，在細胞內作用，所以既不分泌，也不用鎳柱拉下來。
kw_zh: 沒有訊號、沒有 His 標籤
figures.q_en: Why does ccaR carry no 6xHis tag when the cargo genes all do?
figures.q_zh: 貨物基因都帶 6xHis，為什麼 ccaR 沒有？
opt_en: It stays intracellular as the response regulator, so there is nothing to secrete or purify from the medium
A C-terminal tag would block CcaR binding at the PcpcG2 promoter
It was simply left off by mistake during design
The B0015 terminator already provides a purification handle
opt_zh: 它是反應調節蛋白、留在細胞內，沒有東西要分泌或從培養液純化
C 端標籤會阻擋 CcaR 結合 PcpcG2 啟動子
設計時單純漏掉了
B0015 終止子已經提供了純化用的把手
figures.trap_en: Expecting every CDS in the kit to carry a secretion signal and a His tag.
figures.trap_zh: 以為這套工具包裡每個 CDS 都該帶分泌訊號和 His 標籤。

figures.ask_en: How does this map differ from the BoPep4 2.1 map in the same vector?
figures.ask_zh: 這張圖和同一載體裡的 BoPep4 2.1 地圖差在哪？
figures.a_en: Barely at all. Same pSTK-0C vector, same chloramphenicol acetyltransferase and ColE1 origin, same fusion drawn as one arrow with 6xHis beneath. This one reads 2264 bp and the 2.1 map reads 2263. But both inserts are deposited at 183 bp, so that one-base gap is a drawing inconsistency, not a real difference. 2.1 and 2.2 are codon variants of the same 69 bp peptide.
figures.a_zh: 幾乎沒差。同一個 pSTK-0C 載體，同樣的氯黴素乙醯轉移酶和 ColE1 起點，同樣用一個箭頭畫完整個融合、下面標 6xHis。這張寫 2264 bp，2.1 那張寫 2263。但兩個插入片段都登記為 183 bp，所以那一個鹼基的差距是畫圖不一致，不是真的差異。2.1 和 2.2 是同一段 69 bp 胜肽的密碼子變體。
kw_zh: 兩個插入片段都是 183 bp
figures.q_en: How do BoPep4 2.1 and 2.2 actually differ?
figures.q_zh: BoPep4 2.1 和 2.2 實際上差在哪裡？
opt_en: They are codon variants of the same 69 bp peptide and are the same length
2.2 is one base longer, exactly as the two map totals show
2.2 swaps the SamyQ signal peptide for Csn
2.2 carries a second His tag at the N-terminus
opt_zh: 它們是同一段 69 bp 胜肽的密碼子變體，長度相同
2.2 多一個鹼基，就和兩張圖的總長一樣
2.2 把 SamyQ 訊號胜肽換成 Csn
2.2 在 N 端多帶一個 His 標籤
figures.trap_en: Trusting the 1 bp difference between the two map totals as a real sequence difference.
figures.trap_zh: 把兩張圖總長相差的 1 bp 當成真正的序列差異。

figures.ask_en: The page title says Csn. What does the label under this map say?
figures.ask_zh: 頁面標題寫 Csn。這張圖下面的標示寫什麼？
figures.a_en: SamyQ. The bold name reads ccaSR-SamyQ-AcdS-Histag, and that contradicts the page, which is CcaSR-Csn-AcdS-Histag. The map's own feature settles it: the fourth unit is annotated CDS-Csn_Acc, and the deposited sequence for BBa_260MVA1K is the Csn version at 6061 bp. So the page and the feature arrow are right and the bottom label is a mislabel. This map also prints no total length.
figures.a_zh: 寫 SamyQ。粗體名稱是 ccaSR-SamyQ-AcdS-Histag，這和頁面的 CcaSR-Csn-AcdS-Histag 矛盾。圖上自己的特徵就能判定：第四個單元註解為 CDS-Csn_Acc，而 BBa_260MVA1K 存放的序列是 6061 bp 的 Csn 版本。所以頁面和特徵箭頭是對的，底下的構築名稱標錯了。這張圖也沒有印出總長度。
figures.q_en: Page title and map label disagree. Which one does the deposited sequence back?
figures.q_zh: 頁面標題和地圖標示矛盾。存放的序列支持哪一個？
opt_en: The page and the map's own CDS-Csn_Acc feature; the bold name at the bottom is wrong
The bold name at the bottom; the page title was never updated
Both, because SamyQ and Csn are two names for the same signal peptide
It cannot be decided from this figure alone
opt_zh: 頁面以及圖上自己的 CDS-Csn_Acc 特徵；底下的粗體名稱是錯的
底下的粗體名稱；頁面標題一直沒更新
兩者皆可，因為 SamyQ 和 Csn 是同一個訊號胜肽的兩種叫法
光靠這張圖無法判斷
figures.trap_en: Reading the bold construct name under a map as the authoritative identity of the plasmid.
figures.trap_zh: 把地圖下方的粗體構築名稱當成這個質體身分的權威依據。

figures.ask_en: What is this map, and what can you not tell from it?
figures.ask_zh: 這是什麼圖？有什麼是你從圖上看不出來的？
figures.a_en: The BoPep4 2.2 expression construct in pSTK-EXP1: pVeg, RiboJ, R0-RBS, the fusion drawn as one arrow, 6xHis, B0015. That is 712 bp of insert on the 6098 bp EXP1 backbone with Erm, bla, repB and ColE1, 6810 bp in all. What you cannot tell is which BoPep4 variant it is. The arrow is labelled SamyQ-Bopep4-v2t1 and the 2.1 map is the same length with the same label.
figures.a_zh: pSTK-EXP1 裡的 BoPep4 2.2 表達構築：pVeg、RiboJ、R0-RBS、用一個箭頭畫完的融合、6xHis、B0015。那是 712 bp 的插入片段，放在 6098 bp 的 EXP1 骨架上，含 Erm、bla、repB 和 ColE1，全長 6810 bp。看不出來的是它究竟是哪個 BoPep4 變體：箭頭標示為 SamyQ-Bopep4-v2t1，而 2.1 那張圖長度相同、標示也相同。
figures.q_en: How would you tell this plasmid apart from the BoPep4 2.1 version?
figures.q_zh: 你要怎麼把這個質體和 BoPep4 2.1 版本分開？
opt_en: You cannot from the map: same length, same features, same arrow label. You need the sequence
The 2.2 plasmid is one base longer than the 2.1 plasmid
The 2.1 version uses the Csn signal peptide instead of SamyQ
The 2.2 version carries an extra RiboJ insulator
opt_zh: 從圖上分不出來：長度一樣、特徵一樣、箭頭標示也一樣，要看序列
2.2 的質體比 2.1 多一個鹼基
2.1 版本用的是 Csn 訊號胜肽，不是 SamyQ
2.2 版本多帶一個 RiboJ 絕緣子
figures.trap_en: Assuming two different part numbers must look different on a plasmid map.
figures.trap_zh: 以為兩個不同的部件編號在質體圖上一定看起來不一樣。

figures.ask_en: Which signal peptide is on this one, and how does the length show it?
figures.ask_zh: 這個用的是哪個訊號胜肽？長度怎麼看得出來？
figures.a_en: Csn. The fusion is drawn as a single arrow, Csn-AcdS-Histag, in pSTK-EXP1 at 7767 bp. The SamyQ version of the same unit is 7752, which is 15 bp smaller, exactly Csn 108 minus SamyQ 93. The deposited inserts agree: 1669 against 1654. Everything else is the same 6098 bp backbone with Erm, bla, repB and ColE1, so length is the one number separating the two pictures.
figures.a_zh: 是 Csn。融合被畫成單一箭頭 Csn-AcdS-Histag，在 pSTK-EXP1 裡是 7767 bp。同一單元的 SamyQ 版本是 7752，小 15 bp，正好是 Csn 的 108 減 SamyQ 的 93。存放的插入片段也對得上：1669 對 1654。其餘都是同樣的 6098 bp 骨架，含 Erm、bla、repB 和 ColE1，所以長度是分辨兩張圖的唯一數字。
figures.q_en: Why does the team carry both a Csn and a SamyQ version of each cargo?
figures.q_zh: 為什麼每個貨物都同時做了 Csn 和 SamyQ 兩個版本？
opt_en: They are two Sec signal peptides being compared head to head for secretion of the same protein
Csn works in E. coli and SamyQ works in B. subtilis
SamyQ is the His-tagged variant and Csn is the untagged one
Csn is used at Level 1 and SamyQ only at Level 2
opt_zh: 那是兩個 Sec 訊號胜肽，拿來正面比較同一個蛋白的分泌效果
Csn 在大腸桿菌裡有效，SamyQ 在枯草桿菌裡有效
SamyQ 是帶 His 標籤的版本，Csn 是不帶標籤的
Csn 用在 Level 1，SamyQ 只用在 Level 2
figures.trap_en: Treating one of the two signal peptides as a failed version rather than as one arm of a comparison.
figures.trap_zh: 把兩個訊號胜肽裡的一個當成失敗的版本，而不是比較實驗的其中一組。

figures.ask_en: Why does this unit exist, and why are Ho1 and pcyA drawn as one piece?
figures.ask_zh: 這個單元為什麼要存在？Ho1 和 pcyA 為什麼被畫成一段？
figures.a_en: It makes the chromophore. Ho1 turns heme into biliverdin and PcyA reduces that to PCB, which CcaS needs in order to sense green light, and B. subtilis does not make PCB on its own. The two enzymes are joined by a GGGGS double linker and expressed as one fusion, which is why the arrows abut. Driven by PtagC+RBS, closed by L3S2P21: 1655 bp of a 3754 bp pSTK-1A plasmid.
figures.a_zh: 它負責做發色團。Ho1 把血紅素轉成膽綠素，PcyA 再把它還原成 PCB，而 CcaS 需要 PCB 才能感測綠光，枯草桿菌自己不會做 PCB。兩個酵素由 GGGGS 雙重連接子接在一起、以單一融合蛋白表達，所以兩個箭頭是相連的。由 PtagC+RBS 驅動、L3S2P21 收尾：3754 bp 的 pSTK-1A 質體裡的 1655 bp。
kw_zh: Ho1 與 PcyA 做出 PCB
figures.q_en: What does the GGGGS x2 linker between Ho1 and pcyA mean here?
figures.q_zh: Ho1 和 pcyA 之間的 GGGGS x2 連接子在這裡代表什麼？
opt_en: The two enzymes are translated as a single fusion protein, which raises PCB output
It is a scar left behind by the Golden Gate junction
It separates two independent CDSs, each with its own RBS
It is the site where signal peptidase cuts the product
opt_zh: 兩個酵素以單一融合蛋白轉譯，可以提高 PCB 產量
那是 Golden Gate 接點留下的 scar
它分隔兩個各自帶 RBS 的獨立 CDS
那是訊號胜肽酶切開產物的位置
figures.trap_en: Counting Ho1 and pcyA as two separately expressed genes in one operon.
figures.trap_zh: 把 Ho1 和 pcyA 當成同一個操縱組裡兩個各自表達的基因。

figures.ask_en: This is Csn-LEA14. What should it weigh against the SamyQ version?
figures.ask_zh: 這是 Csn-LEA14。它和 SamyQ 版本相比應該差多少？
figures.a_en: Fifteen base pairs more, if the signal peptide is the only change. The SamyQ-LEA14 2.1 map in the same pSTK-0C vector is 2645 bp and this one is 2660, which fits Csn 108 against SamyQ 93. But the deposited lengths are 582 and 564, which is 18 apart. Those two gaps do not match, so three bases somewhere need checking. Otherwise it is the same picture: one fusion arrow, 6xHis, CAT, ColE1.
figures.a_zh: 如果只換訊號胜肽，應該多 15 個鹼基對。同一個 pSTK-0C 載體裡的 SamyQ-LEA14 2.1 地圖是 2645 bp，這張是 2660，正好符合 Csn 的 108 對 SamyQ 的 93。但存放的長度是 582 和 564，相差 18。這兩個差距對不上，所以有三個鹼基需要查。其餘都一樣：一個融合箭頭、6xHis、CAT、ColE1。
figures.q_en: Compare the two length gaps between the Csn and SamyQ LEA14 parts. What do you find?
figures.q_zh: 比較 Csn 與 SamyQ 版 LEA14 的兩組長度差，你發現什麼？
opt_en: 15 bp on the plasmid maps against 18 bp on the deposited lengths; they disagree by three bases
15 bp and 15 bp; the maps and the deposited lengths agree
18 bp and 18 bp; the maps and the deposited lengths agree
They cannot be compared, because the two parts sit in different vectors
opt_zh: 質體圖上差 15 bp，存放長度差 18 bp；兩者差了三個鹼基
都是 15 bp；圖和存放長度一致
都是 18 bp；圖和存放長度一致
無法比較，因為兩個部件在不同載體裡
figures.trap_en: Checking only one of the two length pairs and calling the pair of parts consistent.
figures.trap_zh: 只對了其中一組長度就說這兩個部件沒問題。

figures.ask_en: This is the same 6810 bp as the BoPep4 2.2 map. Is that right?
figures.ask_zh: 這張和 BoPep4 2.2 的圖同樣是 6810 bp。這樣對嗎？
figures.a_en: Yes, and here two maps agreeing is the correct answer. Both BoPep4 Level 1 units are deposited at 712 bp and both sit on the 6098 bp pSTK-EXP1 backbone, so both plasmids come to 6810. The pSTK-0C maps of the same two inserts print 2263 and 2264, and those cannot both be right. Features here: pVeg, RiboJ, the fusion arrow, 6xHis, B0015, Erm and bla.
figures.a_zh: 對，而且這裡兩張圖數字一樣才是正確的。兩個 BoPep4 的 Level 1 單元都登記為 712 bp，也都放在 6098 bp 的 pSTK-EXP1 骨架上，所以兩個質體都是 6810。同樣這兩個插入片段的 pSTK-0C 地圖卻印成 2263 和 2264，那兩個不可能都對。這裡的特徵：pVeg、RiboJ、融合箭頭、6xHis、B0015、Erm 和 bla。
figures.q_en: Which pair of BoPep4 maps is internally consistent with the deposited lengths?
figures.q_zh: 哪一組 BoPep4 地圖和存放長度彼此一致？
opt_en: The two pSTK-EXP1 maps, both 6810 bp, matching two 712 bp inserts
The two pSTK-0C maps, 2263 and 2264 bp
Neither pair matches its deposited lengths
Both pairs do, since one base is within normal drawing error
opt_zh: 兩張 pSTK-EXP1 地圖，都是 6810 bp，對應兩個 712 bp 的插入片段
兩張 pSTK-0C 地圖，2263 與 2264 bp
兩組都和存放長度對不上
兩組都一致，因為一個鹼基在畫圖誤差範圍內
figures.trap_en: Assuming a one-base difference is too small to be an error worth naming.
figures.trap_zh: 以為差一個鹼基太小，不值得當成錯誤提出來。
